verdicts.reason: A: the phone sits right of centre while the headline and subcopy are left-aligned and the badge and CTA are centred, so nothing shares an axis. There is also a big dead gap between the headline and its subcopy, and the leftover cream circle is cut off at the bottom-left edge. B makes the same mixed-alignment and stray-circle mistakes and leaves a large empty band at the top, but its phone is centred and the headline, subcopy, badge and CTA sit as a tighter group, so it reads as slightly more deliberate. Neither is ship-ready: the subcopy is tiny and the 'Online only' badge floats alone instead of sitting with the CTA.
